name: Episil Technologies Inc.
summary: Episil Technologies Inc. provides foundry for linear bipolar IC, and foundry with compound GaN and SiC in Taiwan. It also offers High Power MOSFET, Mix-mode integrated circuit, high voltage CMOS, FRD, TVS, SiC, FRMOS, and GaN discrete device manufacturing services, as well as professional services. The company was formerly known as Episil Holding Inc. Episil Technologies Inc. was founded in 1985 and is headquartered in Hsinchu City, Taiwan.
